Name: Auto Collector
Author: Herikliz
Description:
Tired of running around your farm to collect every single item, pet every animal, and harvest every crop manually? [b]Auto Collector[/b] is here to save your time!

With a single key press, this mod automatically interacts with the environment around you, gathering items, harvesting resources, and taking care of your animals. It is highly customizable, allowing you to choose exactly what you want to collect.

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
Press the collection key (Default: [b]R[/b]) to automatically:
[list]
[*][b]Collect Forageables:[/b] Instantly pick up items from the ground.[/*]
[*][b]Dig Artifact Spots:[/b] Automatically hoes artifact spots (worms/stems) in the area.[/*]
[*][b]Harvest Crops:[/b] Gathers all your ready crops. By default, it smartly ignores flowers near Bee Houses to preserve your flavored honey (can be forced to collect in the settings!).[/*]
[*][b]Collect Machines & Fish Ponds:[/b] Empties ready machines (furnaces, kegs, etc.) and Fish Ponds directly into your inventory.[/*]
[*][b]Pet Animals & Player Pet:[/b] Gives daily love to your farm animals and your personal pet.[/*]
[*][b]Collect Bushes:[/b] Shakes bushes during berry seasons (Salmonberries and Blackberries).[/*]
[*][b]Collect Moss & Tree Seeds:[/b] Cleans moss off trees and shakes normal trees to drop their seeds.[/*]
[*][b]Harvest Fruit Trees:[/b] Gathers fruits directly from your fruit trees.[/*]
[*][b]Check Garbage Cans:[/b] Rummages through town garbage cans. Includes a [b]Safe Garbage[/b] toggle so NPCs won't catch you and get disgusted (optional)![/*]
[*][b]Collect and Reload Crab Pots:[/b] Automatically harvests your crab pots and refills them with bait if you have it in your inventory.[/*]
[*][b]Auto-Pan:[/b] Automatically pans for ores in the water if you are carrying a Pan.[/*]
[*][b]Fill Pet Bowl:[/b] Automatically waters your pet's bowl if you are carrying a Watering Can with water.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Stamina Management[/b][/size]
To keep the game balanced, the mod can consume stamina for actions that normally require it (like digging artifact spots or watering the pet bowl).
[list]
[*][b]Spend Stamina:[/b] Toggle whether the mod should consume your energy.[/*]
[*][b]Safe Stamina:[/b] If enabled, the mod will automatically stop performing actions that cost stamina if your energy drops too low (15 or less), preventing you from accidentally passing out from exhaustion.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
This mod fully supports [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b]. You can customize the hotkey and toggle every single feature on or off directly in-game without having to edit any files.

[size=4][b]Languages[/b][/size]
Fully translated into 16 languages: English, Portuguese, Chinese, Turkish, Russian, Polish, Dutch, Korean, Japanese, Italian, Hungarian, Hebrew, French, Spanish, German, and Czech!
